pages.title: Energy Heatmap
pages.text: Load by Cell — Connected & Running Connected = total rated Power (KVA) actually wired in. Running = Connected × Efficiency Factor (default 20% as the plant default; a machine with its own factor on its Add/Edit page uses that instead) — a more realistic estimate of actual average draw.
